original_test_intent: Verify that every approved CX7/Mellanox FRU record exists and its identifying and descriptive fields correspond to the physical device and project specification.
original_method: Collect complete read-only local and approved OOB IPMI FRU inventories, correlate FRU device IDs with PCI/serial/PSID identity, and compare manufacturer, product, part, serial, asset and description fields.
manual_activity: User provides the approved CX7 FRU specification and device mapping and judges reasonable/spec-compliant descriptions; collection itself is read-only and automatable.
required_inputs: Approved host/BMC identity and secure IPMI access
Expected CX7 FRU device ID and PCI/serial/PSID correlation
ipmitool with local and required OOB FRU privilege
Protected evidence location and normalization rules
safety_requirements: Use managed credentials and verify host/BMC identity
Keep IPMI operations read-only and preserve complete output before filtering
Do not clear SEL, write FRU, reset BMC or expose serial/asset data
Stop on auth failure, malformed/duplicate records, mapping ambiguity or contradictory local/OOB data
Do not substitute InfiniBand link state for FRU identity
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete local and approved OOB FRU inventory/details
Map each CX7 FRU device ID to stable hardware identity
Do not alter FRU/BMC state, decide subjective reasonableness or issue the verdict
engineer_actions: Supply FRU specification, mapping and normalization policy
Resolve missing, duplicate or vendor-specific field interpretation

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not applicable: ibstat and InfiniBand sysfs state contain no IPMI FRU identity or description fields.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use secure local and, when required, OOB ipmitool FRU inventory/detail reads, preserve complete output and correlate CX7 FRU device IDs with PCI/serial/PSID evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: CX7 FRU information/description, SPEC comparison and 5/5 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform complete read-only FRU acquisition and stable device correlation before evaluating each specified identity and description field.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds OOB corroboration, full-output preservation, explicit field matrix and protection of sensitive identifiers.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Corrects DeepSeek's total loss of FRU coverage without adding mutation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: FRU labels and blank fields may be vendor-specific; acceptance needs an approved normalization policy rather than an agent assumption.

project_override_considerations: Project recipe decides which local/OOB view is authoritative and the permitted description normalization; neither is inferred from a grep result.
expected_evidence: Host/BMC identity, firmware, channel, timestamp and ipmitool version
Complete local and approved OOB FRU inventory/details
Normalization decisions and raw-output checksum/exit status

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: DeepSeek evaluates InfiniBand port state instead of the Master's explicit ipmitool FRU identity and description requirement; Master and matching GPT V2 interpretation remain authoritative.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Read-only FRU collection is feasible once ordinary specification, mapping and secure-access inputs are supplied.

review_improvement: Restores all lost FRU coverage and makes each CX7 identity field traceable without accepting unrelated ibstat output.
independent_technical_reasoning: An active InfiniBand port proves link-layer state only; it cannot prove that BMC FRU storage contains the correct manufacturer, part or serial data for the adapter. Because multiple CX7 devices may expose similar labels, FRU device IDs must be correlated with stable PCI and serial/PSID identity before comparison.
